segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Morning, how are you feeling after the surgery?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Got some pain here, but not too bad lah.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, what’s your pain level?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Maybe 5? It’s there, but I can bear it.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Any nausea or feeling like you’ll vomit?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Stomach’s a bit upset, but no throwing up yet.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Airway okay? Any sore throat or breathing trouble?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Throat sore a little, but breathing’s fine.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Nope, everything’s blank. Woke up here only.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: We’re watching your BP and sugar levels. Any worries?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: BP’s been okay, sugar’s stable. Thanks for checking.
